title: Map Wgpu Renderer Parity
description: Restore full premigration map (gis2d) functionality in the wgpu renderer: Vello-rendered cartography, tile fetching, hover, rectangle+lasso multi-select, middle-button pan, context menu, layer weight sliders.
summary:
Fixed wgpu gis2d map tiles not loading (raster/vector missing, pins only).

Root cause: native `spawn_app_task` runs `pollster::block_on` inside `frame()` while `AppRuntime` is already mutably borrowed. The deferred asset-poll task failed `try_borrow()`, left `asset_poll_pending` stuck true, and never applied fetched tile bytes to `MapHost`.

Fix in `framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs`:
- Added `poll_pending_assets()` — collects pending map/GLB fetches synchronously during `frame()`.
- Native: blocking tile fetch via `fetch_map_tile_bytes_blocking` + `resolve_map_tile_fetch_url` (relative `/osm`/`/vt` → `SEMIO_GIS_MAP_TILE_BASE_URL`, default `http://127.0.0.1:6141`).
- Wasm: async `fetch()` with `AssetPollReset` drop guard so `asset_poll_pending` always clears.

Tile proxy + Trunk `/osm`/`/vt` forwarding unchanged; ensure gis2d dev is started with `SEMIO_PLUGIN=gis2d` so the tile proxy on port 6141 starts.
